description: Apple CRUD pages: Settings, Plans, Rooms. Restyle each surface to the Apple system — headers, primary actions, tables/badges, status tints, dialogs — AND replace the hand-rolled toggles in these three files with the new ToggleSwitch (color blue for config/status toggles, green for the Settings prorate toggle to match iOS Settings). Depends on FEAT-001. Files: components/settings/SettingsForm.tsx, components/plans/PlansClient.tsx, components/rooms/RoomsClient.tsx, components/rooms/RoomCard.tsx. Each touched once; no overlap with FEAT-002 or FEAT-004.
steps: components/settings/SettingsForm.tsx (Apple Settings app style): TabsList -> className 'mb-6 w-full' (use the new Apple pill TabsList from FEAT-001; remove any bg-white/border override). Each Card uses the new Apple defaults; CardTitle -> 'text-[15px] font-semibold text-[#1C1C1E]'. Inputs: remove every className='rounded-lg' override (Input is Apple now). Receipt <textarea> -> 'w-full rounded-xl border border-[#E5E5EA] px-3 py-2 text-sm text-[#1C1C1E] focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#007AFF]'. Billing radios keep but change accent-green-500 -> accent-[#007AFF]. Prorate row: restructure to a flex justify-between row with the LABEL on the LEFT and a <ToggleSwitch checked={prorateFirstMonth} onChange={(v)=>setValue('prorateFirstMonth',v)} color='green' /> on the RIGHT (replace the <button>+<span> knob block around line 215-227); remove the redundant onClick label-toggle or keep it but make the switch the single source of truth. SaveButton / Change Password Button: use DEFAULT variant (Apple blue) — remove 'bg-green-500 hover:bg-green-600 ... rounded-lg'. Success banner -> 'bg-[#34C759]/10 text-[#34C759] ... rounded-xl'; error banner -> 'bg-[#FF3B30]/10 text-[#FF3B30] ... rounded-xl' (remove green-50/red-50 borders). Keep the Security tab outside the main <form> (do not restructure that). Import ToggleSwitch from '@/components/ui/toggle-switch'.

components/plans/PlansClient.tsx: h1 -> 'text-[22px] font-semibold text-[#1C1C1E]'; subtitle -> 'text-[#8E8E93] mt-1'; Add Plan Button -> className 'rounded-xl' DEFAULT variant (remove bg-green-600). Empty-state tile 'bg-[#F2F2F7] text-[#8E8E93]'. Desktop table container -> 'hidden md:block bg-white rounded-2xl overflow-hidden' with Apple shadow via style or shadow class 'shadow-[0_1px_3px_rgba(0,0,0,0.08),0_1px_2px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)]' (remove border-gray-100); header TableRow remove 'bg-gray-50'; TableHead cells -> 'text-xs uppercase tracking-wide font-medium text-[#8E8E93]' (remove font-semibold text-gray-700); rows hover bg-[#F2F2F7]/50. Type badge -> 'text-[#007AFF] border-transparent bg-[#007AFF]/10' (remove blue-50/blue-200). Meal badges: Breakfast -> 'text-[#FF9500] border-[#FF9500]/20 bg-[#FF9500]/10' (Coffee icon), Lunch -> 'text-[#34C759] border-[#34C759]/20 bg-[#34C759]/10' (Sun), Dinner -> 'text-[#5856D6] border-[#5856D6]/20 bg-[#5856D6]/10' (Moon). Price -> 'text-[#1C1C1E]'. Status: Active -> 'text-[#34C759] border-transparent bg-[#34C759]/10', Inactive -> 'text-[#8E8E93] border-transparent bg-[#8E8E93]/10'. Mobile cards -> 'rounded-2xl border border-[#E5E5EA]' + Apple shadow (remove border-gray-100). Dialog inputs/selects/buttons: remove className='rounded-lg' overrides (primitives are Apple); Add/Update Button DEFAULT variant rounded-xl (remove bg-green-600). Meal checkboxes keep but accent-green-500 -> accent-[#007AFF]. Replace the isActive toggle (around line 430) with <ToggleSwitch checked={isActive} onChange={(v)=>setValue('isActive',v)} color='blue' size='md' /> (remove the <button>+<span> knob block). Import ToggleSwitch.

components/rooms/RoomsClient.tsx: h1 -> 'text-[22px] font-semibold text-[#1C1C1E]'; subtitle -> 'text-[#8E8E93] mt-1'; Add Room Button DEFAULT variant rounded-xl (remove bg-green-600). Filter pills: active -> 'bg-[#007AFF]/10 text-[#007AFF]', inactive -> 'bg-white text-[#8E8E93] border border-[#E5E5EA]', all 'rounded-xl' (replace bg-green-100/bg-blue-100 and border-gray-200). Empty-state tile 'bg-[#F2F2F7] text-[#8E8E93]'. Dialog: remove className='rounded-lg' overrides on Input/Select; Add/Update Button DEFAULT variant rounded-xl (remove bg-green-600); the error box -> 'bg-[#FF3B30]/10 text-[#FF3B30] ... rounded-lg'. Replace hasSubMeter toggle (~L320) with <ToggleSwitch checked={hasSubMeter} onChange={(v)=>setValue('hasSubMeter',v)} color='blue' /> and isActive toggle (~L340) with <ToggleSwitch checked={isActive} onChange={(v)=>setValue('isActive',v)} color='blue' /> (remove both <button>+<span> knob blocks). Import ToggleSwitch.

components/rooms/RoomCard.tsx: card root -> 'bg-white rounded-2xl border border-[#E5E5EA] shadow-[0_1px_3px_rgba(0,0,0,0.08),0_1px_2px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)] p-4 flex flex-col gap-3' (replace rounded-xl shadow-sm border-gray-100). Room number -> 'text-[#1C1C1E]'. Inactive badge -> 'text-[#8E8E93] border-transparent bg-[#8E8E93]/10'. Sharing badge double -> 'text-[#007AFF] border-transparent bg-[#007AFF]/10', triple -> 'text-[#5856D6] border-transparent bg-[#5856D6]/10'. Floor label -> 'text-[#8E8E93]'. Sub-meter badge -> 'text-[#FF9500] border-transparent bg-[#FF9500]/10'. Bed dots vacant -> 'bg-[#34C759]', occupied -> 'bg-[#FF3B30]'. Footer count -> 'text-[#8E8E93]'. Deactivate button -> 'text-[#FF3B30] border-[#FF3B30]/20 hover:bg-[#FF3B30]/10'; Activate -> 'text-[#34C759] border-[#34C759]/20 hover:bg-[#34C759]/10'. Edit button outline (Apple).
acceptance_criteria: SettingsForm prorate row has label on the left and a green iOS ToggleSwitch on the right; Save/Change-Password buttons are Apple blue; tabs are Apple pill tabs; no rounded-lg input overrides remain; no green-50/red-50 banners.

PlansClient table has no outer border, uppercase #8E8E93 header, #F2F2F7/50 row hover, Apple-tinted type/meal/status badges, and the isActive control is a blue iOS ToggleSwitch; Add Plan button is Apple blue.
RoomsClient filter pills use the blue/gray Apple states, both hasSubMeter and isActive controls are blue iOS ToggleSwitches, and Add Room button is Apple blue.
RoomCard is rounded-2xl with Apple shadow, bed dots use #34C759/#FF3B30, and badges use Apple tints.
Running `npm run build` passes with 0 TypeScript errors.
verification: Optionally npm run dev and visit /plans and /rooms and toggle isActive/hasSubMeter to confirm iOS switches.
